title: Optimal and Diffusion Transports in Machine Learning
tldr_zh: 用连续性方程与速度场非唯一性统一 flow matching、OT、W 梯度流与 transformer PDE 的非形式化综述
tldr_en: Informal survey unifying flow matching, OT, Wasserstein gradient flows and transformer PDEs via the continuity equation and non-unique velocity fields.
key_numbers: No experiments; Prop. 2 vs Prop. 4: flow-matching map equals OT map for Gaussians only when Sigma_0 and Sigma_1 commute (Sec. 4.2)
Prop. 3: for alpha_0=N(0,I), v_t(x)=x/t+((1-t)/t) grad log alpha_t(x) is a gradient field (Sec. 3.3)
Eq. (11)-(12): W_2^2 = min kinetic energy, minimizer alpha_t=((1-t)Id+tT)#alpha_0 (Sec. 4.2)
